headline: Barbie Wants to Get to Know Your Child
snippet: With the help of A.I., America’s most famous doll tries to fulfill a timeless dream — convincing little girls that she’s a real friend. What will happen if they believe her?

headline: Udacity Says It Can Teach Tech Skills to Millions, and Fast
snippet: The online teaching start-up’s “nanodegree” program lets students take their time, offers personalized grading and rewards those who finish.

headline: Finalists for the Vendy Rookie Award Are Announced
snippet: The Street Vendor Project selects the best newcomers among New York food trucks.
